column1: # Dreams Editor menu bindings (spec 008 phase 1, step 2): every July leaf -> retail.
# One row per leaf of the July 1997 demo's menu tree (recomp/windream/editor/editor_tree.py
# extracts it from DREAMS.EXE), then our own entries. Columns:
#   node    the July node symbol, or +Name for an entry of ours
#   value   the July value as symbol+offset (checked against the extracted tree); for our
#           gap entries the same notation, translated by the working-record bases
#   rule    keep       retail reads the field, meaning unchanged: July label and range
#           relabel    retail meaning changed: our label (and range, flags) from the reader
#           widen      the final bank holds values outside the July range: the new range
#                      contains it (a negative minimum centres the slider: symmetric ranges)
#           no-effect  the bank sets it, no retail code reads it: kept so the data stays
#           hide       no retail reader and never set in the bank: not installed
#           not-wired  shown with its July label, bound to a host-only cell that starts at
#                      the retail global's value (Option > Camera, spec 008 A4.4)
#           retail-node  replaced by an existing retail node (the exit node 0x4a4784)
#           gap        ours: a field retail reads and the final bank uses, July lacks
#           group      ours: a new group in Cryo's "... 2..." style
#   retail  the retail address bound: working record base + offset (A3), _Sema* July + 0x3df34c,
#           engine globals one by one (A3 "Engine globals")
#   min max mask flags label   overrides; empty keeps the July value
#   parent  moves the node there, last (July nodes) or places our entry
#   reader  the retail instructions that prove the binding (tests/recomp/test_editor_tree.py
#           checks each against the lifted code); DREAMSFX.EXE:0x... is the DOS Glide build
#   note    the retail reader and meaning
